name: com.gameframex.unity.operationclipboard.kuaishouminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Clipboard (KuaiShou Mini Game)
description:
KuaiShou Mini Game clipboard adapter for GameFrameX OperationClipboard. Self-registers into OperationClipboardRegistry at startup via KuaiShouMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap (code is stripped and registration does not happen when UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD macros are not enabled; installation implies registration).

GameFrameX OperationClipboard 的快手小游戏粘贴板适配渠道包。通过 KuaiShouMiniGameOperationClipboardBootstrap 在启动阶段自注册进主包 OperationClipboardRegistry（宏 UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONCLIPBOARD 未启用时代码被裁剪，注册不会发生；引用即注册）。
